integrity: The attached Python program enumerates all 336 automorphisms, cellular incidences and class characters; rational rank uses independent opposite inequalities rather than extrapolating from finite-field ranks. Mathematical review is not independent.
scientific_limitations: Only the Heawood graph and unordered collision-free two-particle configurations are treated. Rational automorphism characters are determined, but the integral automorphism lattice, first-homology torsion and equivariant homotopy type are not. Potential unindexed equivalent earlier work remains a priority risk.
title: Two irreducible rational summands in Heawood two-point configuration homology
